name: bizapps-community
description: BizApps Community — AI-synthesized, member-driven online community built on BizApps Collaboration.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-core run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-entities run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-core-entities-server run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-actions run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-server run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-ng-widgets run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/community-ng run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node scripts/check-downstream-names.mjs && node --test scripts/check-downstream-names.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/Core/src/rules.test.ts packages/Entities/src/subtype-resolvers.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/server-drivers.test.ts packages/Server/src/server.test.ts packages/AngularWidgets/src/ui-drivers.test.ts packages/Angular/src/client-bootstrap.test.ts
